verdict.rationale: Pilot delivers the month-end outcome as a managed service. Its human bookkeeping team finalizes the books each month and raises outstanding items through the portal. Integrations auto-classify bank and card transactions, and AI answers questions about past transactions. However, nothing shows an AI agent running reconciliation end-to-end with the user directing it, and there is no public API (OpenAPI probes 404) for driving it agentically. Missing for 10: agent-driven transaction matching, automated exception flagging by an agent, agent-prepared close packages for human review, any API or agent interface, and independent corroboration of AI reconciliation.
